suite: Finite xorshift32 differential seeds, exact snapshot equality, no expected-failure skips

firstCounterexamples.reason: Raw C1 0x84 reaches xterm as IND, while native vte ansi Processor::execute handles only listed C0 and ignores C1. Minimal [0x84] also fails with native cursor row 0 vs xterm row 1.
0x9b starts CSI in xterm, but native VTE execute ignores raw C1. Subsequent valid scalar U+07B3 is therefore consumed differently, not a width-table discrepancy.
Raw 0x9d starts OSC in xterm and swallows following bytes; native ignores C1 then prints following content.
